tasks.label: Setup & build
tasks.detail: Install npm deps, create .dev.vars, build the UI. Safe to re-run.

tasks.label: Setup (no UI build)
tasks.detail: Same as above but skips the production UI build; use with the Vite dev server.

tasks.label: Show LAN address
tasks.detail: Print the URL other devices on your network can open.
tasks.command: ip=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || ipconfig getifaddr en1 2>/dev/null || hostname -I 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1); echo; echo "Open from other devices on your network: http://${ip:-$(hostname)}:8787"; echo

tasks.label: Worker: wrangler dev
tasks.detail: Serve the API and the built UI. Requires npm run build first.
